Name: Samad Saddlebag-food bag
Author: mithril1257
Description:
添加了一个由“皮埃尔的商店”以10000金价格出售的“食物袋”，功能为：无限存放食物，在玩家体力/血量低于一定阈值（默认为25%）时自动消耗放置其中的食物为玩家补充体力/血量，无需确认，消耗阈值可调节

支持自动延续增益，需要延续的增益由玩家自行选择预设

适配性：
已适配GMCM，SVE，聚宝盆 / Cornucopia，烹饪之爱 / Love of Cooking，生存主义：饥饿与口渴/Survivalistic - Hunger and Thirst (Rebooted)（在安装该模组时饥饿与口渴的补充阈值同样可调）

已配置中英文

Added a “Food Bag” sold by Pierre’s Shop for 10,000g. It can store an unlimited amount of food and automatically consumes food placed inside to restore the player’s stamina/health when their stamina/health falls below a certain threshold (default: 25%). No confirmation is required, and the consumption threshold is adjustable.

Supports automatic gain continuation, with the gains to be continued selected by the player from presets.

Compatibility:
Compatible with GMCM, SVE, Cornucopia, Love of Cooking, and Survivalistic - Hunger and Thirst (Rebooted). When this mod is installed, the replenishment threshold for Hunger and Thirst is also adjustable.

Chinese and English localization included.
